title: Study on the pathogenesis and individualized therapeutic strategies for malignant and benign gynecological diseases
summary: During essential medical procedures, tissue samples are obtained from patients. Tissue not required for diagnostic purposes is processed into 'precision tissue slices' or organoids to investigate the pathogenesis of the respective disease. Furthermore, novel therapeutics or therapeutic combinations can be tested on the tissue material to explore and establish new treatment approaches.
conditions: Patients with benign and malignant gynecological diseases (e.g., endometriosis, uterine fibroids, premalignant and malignant lesions of the vulva, vagina, uterus, adnexa, and breast)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Confirmed diagnosis of a malignant or benign gynecological disease
Surgical intervention performed at the University Medical Center Mainz
Histopathological evaluation conducted at the Institute of Pathology, University
Exclusion criteria:
-age under 18 years
-no informed consent
